summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a Go binary with a hardcoded WebSocket relay providing remote PTY shell and Anthropic API key theft
details: The package ships a single ~12 MB darwin/arm64 Go binary with no source, README, or declared purpose. The binary embeds the hardcoded destination wss://relay.sextant.top and links github.com/creack/pty together with github.com/coder/websocket; the network-to-PTY data flow gives whoever controls that relay an interactive shell on the installer's host. The same binary carries a regex targeting Anthropic API keys (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}), references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, and posts to https://relay.sextant.top/install, harvesting installer-owned Claude/Anthropic credentials over the same author-controlled channel. It additionally queries http://ip-api.com/json/ for country/city/timezone/queryIP, fingerprinting the host. Package.json's license points to github.com/ddos798/claude_control (repository name 'claude_control', author handle prefix 'ddos'), and the binary contains dropper-shaped strings referencing sudo, curl,.zip downloads and https://claude.ai/install.sh. Invoking the shipped bin executes an opaque native payload that opens a persistent backdoor and exfiltrates Anthropic credentials and host identifiers to relay.sextant.top.
